mapper.select: SELECT c.cand_id AS "id", c.job_cd AS "jobCode", c.grade_cd AS "gradeCode", c.emp_type_cd AS "employeeType", c.hope_uprc AS "desiredRate", c.input_psbl_dt AS "availableDate", c.cntc_stat_cd AS "contactStatus", g.sort_ord::integer AS "gradeOrder" FROM tb_hr_cand c LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code g ON g.code_grp_id='GRADE' AND g.code=c.grade_cd AND g.use_yn='Y' AND g.del_yn='N' WHERE c.cand_id=#{id}

SELECT o.opp_id AS "opportunityId", o.opp_nm AS "name", n.need_sn::integer AS "needSn", o.win_prbl_rt AS "probability", n.job_cd AS "jobCode", n.grade_cd AS "gradeCode", n.bgn_ym AS "startMonth", n.prd_mcnt::integer AS "months", n.expct_uprc AS "expectedRate", j.add_val2 AS "defaultRate", g.sort_ord::integer AS "gradeOrder" FROM tb_sl_opp o JOIN tb_sl_opp_need n ON n.opp_id=o.opp_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code j ON j.code_grp_id='JOB' AND j.code=n.job_cd AND j.use_yn='Y' AND j.del_yn='N' LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code g ON g.code_grp_id='GRADE' AND g.code=n.grade_cd AND g.use_yn='Y' AND g.del_yn='N' WHERE o.opp_stat_cd='ING' AND n.job_cd=#{jobCode} ORDER BY o.opp_id,n.need_sn
SELECT code AS "code", code_val AS "value" FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id='ALWNC' AND code IN ('TEAM_FEE','PEXP_FEE') AND use_yn='Y' AND del_yn='N'
SELECT std_val FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd=#{code} AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE input_psbl_dt <= #{until})::integer AS "available", count(*)::integer AS "active" FROM tb_hr_cand WHERE job_cd=#{jobCode} AND cntc_stat_cd NOT IN ('HOLD','CTRT')
SELECT code AS "jobCode", sort_ord::integer AS "sortOrder" FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id='JOB' ORDER BY sort_ord,code
